exposure: type of maternity facility (private vs. public)
Type of maternity facility (private vs. public)
cohort: 61,278 births in six municipalities in Santa Catarina, Brazil
finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in private maternity facilities compared to public facilities, particularly among primiparous, Caucasian women, those with greater prenatal care attendance, and those giving birth during daylight hours.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in private maternity facilities compared to public facilities.
